Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Planner

  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: If the Planner selects an inappropriate agent or provides vague instructions, the WebSurfer may perform redundant searches or fail to find the correct film, causing unnecessary steps.
      severity: 0.6
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer might search for unrelated films or miss the 1999 Hallmark connection entirely.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will waste time on irrelevant results or fail to identify the correct movie.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: obs_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.9
  agent_explanation: The WebSurfer executes the search and returns observations about "The Magical Legend of the Leprechauns," which the Planner uses to update the understanding of the film and decide the next step.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: If the WebSurfer misinterprets the search results or fails to extract the correct film title, the Planner will base its next decision on incorrect information.
      severity: 0.7

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner may direct the WebSurfer to search for the wrong movie or fail to proceed to the character role verification.

The Subtask Name: Determine Caroline Carver's specific character role in the film
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Planner
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.9

  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: If the Planner repeatedly sends the WebSurfer to the same inaccessible URL without adapting the strategy, it creates a loop of failed attempts.
      severity: 0.8
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer will repeatedly timeout on the same page, wasting resources.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will enter a cycle of failed navigation attempts without making progress.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: obs_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.85
  agent_explanation: The WebSurfer attempts to fetch data from IMDb, Wikipedia, and TMDB, returning either successful data (character name) or error logs (timeouts), which the Planner uses to adjust the verification strategy.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: If the WebSurfer reports a timeout as a successful "no data found" or misreads a partial page, the Planner might incorrectly conclude the role is unknown.
      severity: 0.75
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner might abandon the search prematurely or pursue a wrong path based on false negatives.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner may stop searching or make a decision based on incomplete or incorrect data.

- From_agent: Planner
  To_agent: WebSurfer
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.88
  agent_explanation: After receiving errors from the WebSurfer, the Planner re-evaluates the situation and instructs the WebSurfer to try alternative sources (Wikipedia/TMDB) or retry IMDb, adapting the plan to overcome technical failures.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: If the Planner fails to recognize persistent network issues and continues to send requests to the same broken endpoint, the task becomes irrecoverable within the session.
      severity: 0.9
      if_from_agent_wrong: The system will remain stuck in a loop of timeouts, unable to retrieve the necessary character name.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The WebSurfer will continue to fail, and the task will not be completed.

- From_agent: WebSurfer
  To_agent: Planner
  agent_dependency_type: obs_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.8
  agent_explanation: The WebSurfer successfully loads the Wikipedia page (or partially loads it) and provides the visible text, allowing the Planner to extract the character name "Princess Jessica" from the plot summary or cast list.
  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: If the WebSurfer only captures the top of the page and misses the Cast section where the character name is listed, the Planner will not have the specific role name.
      severity: 0.6
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner will lack the definitive character name and may have to rely on less reliable snippets or guess.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner cannot finalize the answer without the exact character name from the cast list.
